## Asset Register

The estate's asset list — search, status/criticality/category facets and a location tree, sharing one filtered row set across grid/list/table. Each row's one visual anchor is the tag chip (the monospace Record Identifier), the same anchor Asset's own fitted format uses.

Generic-adjacent: any register of tagged, located, owned things (an IT hardware register, a fleet register) can mount this against its own item shape as long as it carries tag/name/status/criticality/location.

### Non-goals

Not a generic collection shell (boxel-search-with-filter's toolbar is its own reusable piece — Collection Toolbar); this component is the asset-specific facet set on top of it.
